nuggets.text: The Hoosiers went 16-0 last season, the first perfect 16-win FBS season since the 1894 Yale Bulldogs.
The Hoosiers ride a 17-game winning streak into Saturday's game against the Bison.
Fernando Mendoza became the first Hoosier ever to win the Heisman Trophy in 2025.
Hoosiers coach Curt Cignetti famously pitched himself this way: 'It's simple, I win. Google me.'
Curt Cignetti played quarterback at West Virginia behind Oliver Luck and Jeff Hostetler; his father coached the Mountaineers.
Josh Hoover's first pass as a Hoosier went for a 15-yard touchdown, and he finished 13-of-16 with four TD passes.
The Hoosiers are 3-0 against FCS teams under Curt Cignetti, outscoring them 191-10.
The Hoosiers had the most all-time losses in major college football until late 2025, then won their first national title.
The prow, mainmast and two guns of the battleship USS Indiana stand at the western entrance of the Hoosiers' stadium.
The Hoosiers' limestone boulder, placed by coach Terry Hoeppner in 2005, was renamed Hep's Rock in his honor in 2010.
